test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements regarding the Exercise INDRA held in March-April 2025 is/are correct?

1. The exercise included participation of Russian Federation Naval Ships Pechanga, Rezkiy, and Aldar Tsydenzhapov, along with Indian Naval Ships Rana, Kuthar, and Maritime Patrol Aircraft P8I.

2. The exercise was conducted in two phases: Harbour phase in Chennai and Sea phase in the Arabian Sea.

3. This was the 13th edition of Exercise INDRA , symbolises the long-term strategic relationship between India and Russia.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Exercise INDRA** held in March-April 2025 included participation of Russian Federation Naval Ships Pechanga, Rezkiy, and Aldar Tsydenzhapov, along with Indian Naval Ships Rana, Kuthar, and Maritime Patrol Aircraft P8I, making Option 1 correct.
 
• The exercise aimed to enhance interoperability and strengthen maritime cooperation between the **Indian Navy and Russian Federation Navy**.
 
• The exercise focused on complex maritime operations such as **anti-submarine warfare, surface warfare, and air defense exercises**.
 
• This iteration of Exercise INDRA was part of the longstanding strategic partnership between India and Russia, showcasing **joint efforts in maintaining maritime security**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exercise INDRA Overview:** A bilateral military exercise between India and Russia, initiated in 2003, aimed at improving joint operational capabilities in land, sea, and air domains.
 
• **Harbour Phase:** This phase typically involves planning sessions, cultural exchanges, and professional interactions between participating naval personnel.
 
• **Sea Phase:** Includes live-action drills such as search-and-rescue operations, naval gunfire, anti-aircraft drills, and coordinated maneuvers.
 
• **Strategic Partnership:** India and Russia have a long history of defense cooperation, including joint military exercises, defense technology sharing, and mutual support in strategic maritime interests.
 
• **Maritime Patrol Aircraft P8I:** A state-of-the-art aircraft used by the Indian Navy for surveillance and reconnaissance operations, equipped with advanced radar systems and weapon capabilities.
